rabbi-yehuda-bar-nachmani.name: Rabbi Yehuda bar Naḥmani
rabbi-yehuda-bar-nachmani.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who served as the disseminator (meturgeman) for Reish Lakish.
rabbi-yehuda-bar-nachmani.prompt: A man in his 40s with a dark beard and a plain linen mantle, standing beside a seated teacher and turning to repeat the lesson aloud to a crowd; background of a crowded stone study hall in Tiberias.

rav-yosef-brei-derav-shemaya.name: Rav Yosef, son of Rav Shemaya
rav-yosef-brei-derav-shemaya.bio: Babylonian Amora who cites a baraita in support of Rav Pappa.
rav-yosef-brei-derav-shemaya.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short brown beard and a dark wool cloak, holding an open hand toward a colleague as he cites a teaching; background of a Babylonian study house with mudbrick walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-nehorai.name: Rabbi Nehorai
rabbi-nehorai.bio: Tanna of the generation of Rabbi Meir; Pirkei Avot (4:14) preserves his saying “Exile yourself to a place of Torah.”
rabbi-nehorai.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a greying beard, a traveller’s cloak and a wooden staff; background of a dusty road leading toward a distant study house at dusk.
